relative_metrics.common_window: The common window starts at max(candidate forward_test_start, primary forward_test_start) and every rel_* metric is computed on both slots' tracking over that shared window via core/tracking.py (compute_tracking with the common start date). Metrics: rel_max_drawdown_diff_pp = candidate MaxDD% - primary MaxDD% (both negative; >= -3 means the candidate's drawdown is no more than 3pp deeper); rel_live_calmar_diff = candidate live Calmar - primary live Calmar, where live Calmar = ((1 + geo_monthly)^12 - 1) / |MaxDD| on the common window; rel_geo_monthly_diff_pp = candidate geo%/mo - primary geo%/mo.
relative_metrics.arbiter: Only the pre-registered pairwise candidate-vs-primary comparison below decides anything. /api/compare displays; this protocol decides.

power_disclosure.note: The candidate and primary books are highly correlated (shared sleeves, same universe), so the paired monthly return difference has SE ~= 1.2pp/mo — far tighter than either slot's own ~4.5pp 12-month SE, but still too weak to confirm a small geo edge. The X12-REL-GEO leg is therefore a weak leg disclosed as such; the DD and Calmar legs (X12-REL-DD, X12-REL-CALMAR, X12-ABS-DD) carry the verdict — drawdown control is the candidate's pitch and is what this test is powered to detect.

three_month_note: The 3-month checkpoint is OPERATIONAL-ONLY. X3-* verify the machine (vol band, slippage, reconciliation) — NO performance decisions of any kind are taken at 3 months, in either direction. This is a pre-commitment against peeking at 3-month returns. The only performance-bearing events before 12 months are the continuous kill XK1 and the pre-registered CRASH1 v2 swap clause (results/v7/crash/CRASH1_PREREG.md), which resets the shadow clock if exercised.

criteria.description: Continuous kill: live drawdown from the forward-test equity peak reaches -40% or worse. Tighter than the primary's -45% — drawdown control is the candidate's pitch; a candidate that draws down 40% has already failed its own thesis.
Continuous kill-or-recost (mirrors primary K2): realized slippage exceeds 25bp/side over >=3 consecutive rebalances.
Continuous operational pause (mirrors primary K3a): fill rate by notional below 90% on two consecutive rebalances.
Continuous operational pause (mirrors primary K3b): achieved-vs-target gross deviation above 15% on two consecutive rebalances.

3-month OPERATIONAL-ONLY check: realized monthly volatility within [6%, 22%]/mo (the tier+freeze stack should run cooler than the primary's [7, 25] band). Operational review only — see three_month_note; no performance decision.
3-month OPERATIONAL-ONLY check: median slippage <= 15bp/side, measured on >= 3 rebalances. Operational review only — see three_month_note; no performance decision.
3-month OPERATIONAL-ONLY check: post-rebalance reconciliation green on at least 2 of the last 3 rebalances. Operational review only — see three_month_note; no performance decision.

12-month SUCCESS requirement (common window, vs primary): candidate MaxDD - primary MaxDD >= -3pp — the candidate's drawdown may be at most 3pp deeper than the primary's over the shared window. Carries verdict weight (power disclosure).

12-month SUCCESS requirement (common window, vs primary): candidate live Calmar >= primary live Calmar (live Calmar = annualized geo return / |MaxDD| on the common window). Carries verdict weight (power disclosure).

12-month SUCCESS requirement (common window, vs primary): candidate geo monthly >= primary geo monthly - 1.0pp/mo (the ~95%-of-return expectation from the assembly ledger). WEAK LEG: paired SE ~1.2pp/mo means this cannot distinguish small differences — disclosed in power_disclosure; the DD/Calmar legs carry the verdict.
12-month SUCCESS requirement (absolute backstop, candidate's own full forward-test window): MaxDD >= -35%. A relative win while both books crater is not a success.

decision_rule.SUCCESS: All four 12-month legs pass (X12-REL-DD, X12-REL-CALMAR, X12-REL-GEO, X12-ABS-DD) -> year-2 promotion discussion.
decision_rule.FAIL: XK1 fired at any time, OR at least 2 of the three X12-REL legs fail at 12 months.
decision_rule.MIXED: Anything else (exactly one REL leg failing, or only the absolute backstop failing) -> MIXED: extend the shadow test; no promotion, no kill. The extension decision and its rationale are documented in a dated amendment.

freeze_disputed.provenance: Parameters originate from the retracted V6 in-sample full-window 135-cell grid; RESCORE_NOTES stability flag 83.3% (< 85% bar); the prescribed dev-window freeze-parameter grid was never run. Ruling in results/v7/candidate_x/DECISION_RULE.md: ship the ledgered construction exactly, freeze included, labeled DISPUTED.
freeze_disputed.ablation_replay: Pre-registered monthly FREEZE ABLATION REPLAY: the bot journals daily weights and freeze multiplier/state per rebalance and scan (core/journal.py freeze_* fields); research replays the identical book each month with the freeze multiplier removed. At the 12-month review, if the freeze's live contribution is negative (costs return without cutting realized MaxDD), freeze is DISABLED in any promoted configuration.
freeze_disputed.adjudication_scope: This is a BINDING CONFIG DECISION at 12 months about the freeze component only. It is NOT a slot pass/fail leg: no X12 leg reads the ablation replay, and the replay cannot save or kill the slot.

amendment_rule: Amendments only via dated amendment sections appended to this file's narrative documents plus a re-issued protocol_exp.json with amended=true (permanent — never reset to false) and its new sha256 recorded alongside the original. A CRASH1 v2 swap (pre-registered in results/v7/crash/CRASH1_PREREG.md) is a NEW protocol binding: new bundle version, new protocol_exp sha bound at the swapped slot's next funded rebalance, 12-month clock reset, old record archived. Any hash mismatch against the sha256 bound at the slot's forward_test_start permanently flags the test MODIFIED_AFTER_START.
